label: Trace covered productive ancestry from source-specific loss of inductive supply (inference)
rule: Transport an original supply derivation in the absence of a selected contributor path
meaning: Induction on supply preserves every derivation with no positive selected path to its endpoint. A lost token therefore has such a path through groups with originally supplied contributors. Coherence on the exercised groups gives the actual occurrences needed for each Step, and ownership identifies the initial bearer. The existing covered-history transfer argument can consume this ancestry with its separate target coverage and causal-credit premises.
